Access Memory: Coalescing Packs Nearby Addresses into 
Fewer Transactions
Coalescing is evaluated for one warp memory instruction. Aligned, contiguous 
addresses touch fewer segments.
▪
Misalignment can cross extra boundaries. Strided accesses can touch many more 
segments.

GPU: Optimize Throughput of a Large Number of Simple Threads
¡ A thread block is assigned to one SM
¡
Up to 8 blocks to each SM
¡
Fermi SM can take up to 1536 threads
¡ Could be 256 * 6 blocks
¡
Or 512 * 3 blocks, etc.
¡
Each block is divided into 32-thread warps
¡
Scheduling by the warp scheduler within a SM.
¡
Single Instruction, Multiple Threads (SIMT) 
abstraction
¡
Threads in a wrap should execution same 
codes/instructions.
¡
However, thread is allowed to execute different 
branches.
